letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai or the gentle breeze of Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this life with you. Today, as the calendar flips to a new day, I feel the same flutter I did on that February morning back in 2025, when we promised forever. Your laughter is my favorite soundtrack, and your smile lights up every corner of my heart. Stay my cutie, my love, my everything—here and wherever our next adventure leads.
poem:
In desert sands or monsoon rain,  
Your love’s the compass, sweet refrain.  
Together we dance, hearts entwine,  
Forever yours, forever mine.
